tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// chag lo'i zhu ba bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ sdom pa gsum ldan rig pa'i gnas lnga thugs su chud// rnam 'byed blo ldan 'dod pa'i lha yis rjes su gzung*// mkhyen brtses chos log tshar gcod skal ldan rjes 'dzin pa// sa skya pa zhes yongs grags bla ma rgyal gyur cig /dpal ldan mar me mdzad dpal ye shes sras// sgra bsgyur nag tsho la sogs mkhas btsun gyi// gdan sa skye dgu'i bde gzhi bstan 'dzin dag /'byung gnas gtsug lag khang chen yang thog nas// thub bstan dam chos phyin ci ma log pa// gangs ri'i khrod du gtso cher spel ba yi// skyes bu dam pas byin rlabs dgon gnas mchog /yongs su grags pa'i dpal ldan sa skyar ni// lung rigs ri sul brten nas 'jigs med par// don ldan seng ge'i nga ros log smra ba'i// wa tshogs skrag mdzad skal ldan rang rigs sdud// rtsod dus mi yi seng ge'i spyan snga ru// shākya'i dge slong khyod sogs dam pa yi// spyan zur phog cing thub pa'i bstan la dad// byang chub che sogs khyad 'phags rten yang mthong*// sgra bsgyur ming can chos rjes zhu phrin 'bul// phyag 'tshal sku khams bde ba'i yi ge yis// mtshon te zhu legs de slad skabs kyi don// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i byi dor bstan bcos che// sdom gsum rab dbye mdzad ces sngon du thos// nyan zhing lta bar 'dod kyang yul gyis bskal// yul 'dir dris kyang dpe thogs med ces grags// slad nas dge bshes ye shes seng ge'i dpe// rgyal zla'i mar ngo'i tshes gnyis nyin mo blangs// tshes gsum snga dro bltas pas po ti la// yig mkhan skyon chags rang yang g.yeng ba che// blo nus chung bas mtha' dag ma rtogs mod// gang rtogs phal cher dad pa'i gnas su go /'on kyang ma rtogs the tshom gang mchis pa// cung zad cig zhu de dag lung bstan gsol// chos dbyings bsngo rgyu min pa med mod kyi// don dam dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan// rim bzhin de bzhin nyid dang 'khor ba kun// nam mkha' so sor brtags min zhes gsung ba// nyan thos nyid bzhed thun mong min pa ci// don dam dge ba de bzhin nyid do zhes// dgongs pa can du 'chad pa'i dgos pa gang*// chos dbyings dge med tsam la dge ba zhes// 'dogs rgyu dge med mi dger mi mtshungs sam// zas kyis 'grangs pa 'dod chags bral ba'i dpe// nyer bstan 'dod chags bral ba mtshan nyid la// gtan nas 'dod chags bral ba'ang bshad pa med// de bzhin chos dbyings don dam dge ba dngos// bde bskyed sbyor 'byung sogs su bshad pa'ang med// thar pa dam pa'i don du dge ba zhes// rnam dag ye shes spyod yul ma lags sam// chos dbyings ma rtogs chos gzhan med gsungs pa// don dam chos dbyings dbang byas ma lags sam// bstan bcos dgongs pa can dang thad ka'i sgra// min par 'chad na 'phags pas gsungs pa yi// bstan bcos sbyor ba'i rgyu drug ma tshang pas// 'phags pa'i rang tshig gong 'og mi 'gal lam// bsngo ba byed tshe chu thigs sbreng byed pa// sngon tshe gtsug lag khang chen rnams na'ang yod// lung nas gsungs zhes smra zhing bal yul na'ang*// dge sbyong kun mdzad re zhig dpyad par rigs// mkhas pa 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pa yis// mdzad pa'i cho gas chos rje shākya dpal// bzang pos skye bo kun la sems bskyed mdzad// de ni byang sa dang mthun ji ltar lags// dbu ma'i lugs kyi sems bskyed 'gro kun la// cho gas bskyed na skye ba mdo lnga sogs// slob dpon gnyis kyis bstan bcos las gsungs kyang*// de 'dra'i cho ga de gang bslab bya gang*// sems bskyed thob nas bslab la ma bslabs kyang*// rgyal bar 'gyur na cho ga sus thob legs// 'on te rgyal sras zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i// bslab btus spyod 'jug bzhin du bsrung 'tshal na// cho ga zlos nas skye bo phal po ches// bslab pa bsrung ba lta zhog bsrung mtshams kyang*// shes par mi nus de la bca' ba las// nyams pa'i nyes sogs 'byung bar mi 'gyur ram// brgya la phag mgo'i dbang bskur gsung srid kyang*// rjes gnang yin gyis dbang bskur min zhes gsung*// gal te gsungs na dbang du brjod pa la// 'gal ba ci mchis rdo rje dril bu pas// sngags gtad pa la sngags kyi dbang du brjod// des na ma gsungs byed nyid mtshar che'am// gsang sngags gsar rnying gnyis la bod kyis ni// sbyar ba'i rgyud sde mang ste gang dag lags// tshig gi sdeb sbyor gang rnams mkhyen pa dang*// rgyan dang mngon brjod phal cher go ba dang*// sdeb sbyor dang ni rgyan gyi bstan bcos dag

/gang dang gang zhig gang dang gang la gsan// gzhan yang gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi po la// nyan bshad yod pa phal cher gsan zhes 'byung*// nyan bshad yod pa'i rgyud kyang du zhig mchis// khyad par dpal ldan brtag pa gnyis pa la// mkhas pa'i 'grel ba rnam bshad du zhig mchis// mtshan brjod bshad pa lugs drug gang dag lags// de rnams rnam dbye sdom gsum rab dbye'i dpe// dag pa zhig gi bka' drin cig nang zhes// 'dzem dgos med par spyi brtol bskyed pa lags// zhu don gzhan yang mchis mod bkra shis grags// mar ngo'i tshes lnga'i nyin mo 'gro zer nas// mar ngo'i tshes bzhi nyin par 'di dag bris// kho bos gus pa'i bsam pas zhus pa 'di// nongs na bzod mdzod dge bas 'gro ba kun// dge bshes dam pa bsten nas thabs mkhas bcas// shes rab grol ba'i bla mas bskyed par shog /chos rje sa skya pa la/ chag lo tsā bas zhus pa'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
